validated_rule: When a reference requires a physical radius around Boolean-generated cut edges, evaluate Boolean before Bevel; keep the cutter live, centered through the host depth, outward-facing, and visually verify the rim. Bevel-before-Boolean remains valid only when a deliberately sharp generated cut is intended.
counterevidence_and_limits: Modifier order is an edge-function choice, not a universal correctness law.
